content: WSJ: “China Has Matched Anthropic in Cybersecurity, Resetting AI Race” China’s Zhipu AI, has matched Anthropic’s Mythos in certain benchmarks, such as exploiting cybersecurity bugs. Well, that’s not good. Instead of blaming the administration which did the correct thing… Anthropic’s clearly at fault for not setting enough guardrails to prevent distillation. Even before Fable release there were a lot of rumors that China had backdoors to distill it. Part of it is the trillions of capex to accelerate the AI moat. And the second part is not handing that work over on a silver platter for millions in API calls.
translated: 《华尔街日报》：“中国在网络安全方面与 Anthropic 不相上下，重启人工智能竞赛” 中国的智普人工智能在某些基准测试中与 Anthropic 的 Mythos 不相上下，例如利用网络安全漏洞。嗯，这不太好。与其责怪做正确事情的政府……人类显然有错，因为没有设置足够的护栏来防止蒸馏。甚至在《神鬼寓言》发行之前，就有很多传言称中国有后门来提取它。其中一部分是加速人工智能护城河的数万亿资本支出。第二部分并不是将这项工作交给数以百万计的 API 调用。

analysis.investment: 暂无针对此推文的具体建议。

content: Robotics is next. Both deal count and investment amounts are skyrocketing per pitchbook March data (source: a16z) Good thing is: the same AI DC exposure often has cross-exposure to humanoid ramp. Like DRAM/NAND with memory (on humanoid inference/storage) or DFB lasers with photonics (FMCW LiDAR vision/sensing). Right now most exposure is upstream component parts… or programs within large players like $AMZN or $TSLA. So global IPO season H2 into 2027 for pure play humanoids/robotics companies is going to be fun.
translated: 机器人技术是下一个。根据 3 月份数据，交易数量和投资金额都在飙升（来源：a16z） 好的一面是：同样的 AI DC 曝光通常会与人形爬坡交叉曝光。就像带有内存的 DRAM/NAND（用于人形推理/存储）或带有光子学的 DFB 激光器（FMCW LiDAR 视觉/传感）。目前，大多数曝光都是上游零部件……或者是 $AMZN 或 $TSLA 等大型企业内部的程序。因此，对于纯粹的类人/机器人公司来说，2027 年下半年的全球 IPO 季将会很有趣。

content: Kinda nutty OpenAI’s is launching its heavyweight 5.6 Sol frontier model on $CBRS. At up to 750 tokens/sec, which is obscene performance. American inference go brrr. I actually picked up starter positions on Cerebras for the first time in the ~170s (below $185 IPO price) after seeing this news yesterday. Feels like validation of its tech. IMO a bit overvalued compared to profitable companies like $JBL at the same valuation. But there’s likely premiums for OpenAI exposure, as long as they stay the leader.
translated: 有点疯狂的 OpenAI 正在 $CBRS 上推出其重量级 5.6 Sol 前沿模型。高达 750 个令牌/秒，这是令人不快的性能。美国的推理去吧。事实上，在昨天看到这个消息后，我在大约 170 年代（低于 185 美元的 IPO 价格）第一次获得了 Cerebras 的首发头寸。感觉像是对其技术的验证。与同等估值的 JBL 等盈利公司相比，IMO 的估值有点高估。但只要 OpenAI 保持领先地位，他们的曝光度就可能会溢价。
